name: Bento Unfold Grid
description: Dark bento grid of icon cards on a dotted glow background. Clicking a card unfolds it into a full-width featured panel with a view transition, and clicking again or the close button restores it.
contents: Optional header with tag pill, title and subtitle
Grid of cards, each with SVG icon, title, description and index number
Featured state with Active badge, Explore button and close button
behavior: Card click expands it to a full-width first row using the View Transitions API when available
Cards lift and glow on hover
Grid is 1, 2 or 3 columns by screen width
